title: 全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师_柠蓝浅夏_第3章 抢疯了！
content_zh:
“只剩下三千多人了。”

他没记错的话，下午的时候当前区域还有六千多人，夜幕降临这么点时间，就死了两千多人？

原本略显沉寂的聊天频道，此刻又沸腾起来。

【编号64568234：卧槽，太恐怖了，刚刚天一下就黑了，好像有什么东西从我面前闪过去了。】

【编号35684521：幸好我提前制作了火把，看来黑暗才是最可怕的。】

【编号23678523：就刚刚一会？死了这么多人吗？那些人究竟遇到了什么？】

【编号00264781：救命啊！有没有谁在附近？我的火把快没了，有黑影在附近徘徊，他们要扑过来了，救救……】

最后一条语音消息，戛然而止。

整个聊天频道都陷入一片死寂，随后彻底炸了。

【编号12562123：兄弟你还在吗？兄弟？】

【编号65861352：怎么办？我的火把好像也坚持不了多久了，谁有多余的树杈交易，食物、水……无论什么东西都行啊！】

【编号20359421：到底是什么怪物？我幸存点不够了换了，呜呜呜——我不想死。】

频道内弥漫着恐慌的气氛，仅仅第一天，就死了一半的人，他们真的能在这个世界生存下来吗？

许默冷汗直冒，刚刚他要是动作再晚点，会不会也遇到那种怪物？

他余光扫了眼周围的黑暗，毛骨悚然的感觉再次袭来。

神经紧绷了一天，他原本都疲倦了，这时候却不敢睡，强打着精神盯着眼前还剩下85%耐久的火把，趁机又多做了两个。

好在，他白天捡的树枝和枯草够多，不愁不够用。

交易行原本交易数量不算少的树枝和枯草，此刻正在肉眼可见的减少，许默点开自己的交易单。

【当前交易：无】

【幸存点：270】

“这……”

太夸张了吧！

他那些酒水挂上去，才过了半个小时？就没了？

看了下负重栏，还有二十多个的酒水，他尝试着挂了一个，这次，他挂的15幸存点。

挂上去的瞬间，立刻就显示交易成功。

“抢疯了！”

许默咽了口唾沫，这帮人对于水和食物的需求，远比他想象的更加疯狂。

看着手上高达285点的幸存点，许默有种手握巨款的感觉，尽管当前的交易价格非常诱人，但许默还是保持了理智，没有将剩下的酒水贸然出手。

285的幸存点数，已经非常夸张了。

翻了十几页后，许默看到两个还算感兴趣的东西。

【炖肉（食物配方）】

【交易点数：35点】

【简易篝火（图纸）】

【交易点数：40点】

“食物配方和图纸？”

许默眼睛一亮，几乎没有怎么犹豫，他就立刻选择了交易。

交易成功，激活图纸后，他原本的【制作】界面又多了两个选择。

【炖肉】

【制作需求：水X2，鲜肉X1】

【简易篝火】

【制作需求：石块X5，木材X2】

许默皱了皱眉。

这个【炖肉】虽然看上去不错，但需要的条件有点过于苛刻了，【鲜肉】交易行上倒是有，可价格却并不便宜。

许默思来想去，暂时没有必要尝试。

至于【简易篝火】，制作需求的石块和木材，可以通过石镐和斧头获取。

可惜白天的时候，许默并没有看到能开采的石头。

好在，这两样东西交易行价格都不算特别贵，许默仅仅花费了3个幸存点，就将所需材料拿到手了。

准备齐全后，他依次点击【制作】【放置】。

紧接着，一簇火光瞬间映现。

一个由石头围起来的篝火映入眼帘，上面燃烧着火焰，照亮的范围比原来的火把大了好几倍！

寒意被驱散后，许默紧绷的神经也松了下来。

随后他发现，自己可以往里面添加燃料，不论是“枯草”、“树杈”还是“木材”，只要是可以燃烧的，统统都行。

这样一来的话，他终于不用担心火把燃尽了，许默就这样守着篝火过了一夜。

次日清晨，当周围的光线再度明亮起来的时候，一夜未眠的许默虽然有些疲惫，但还是强打精神站了起来。

还不是睡觉的时候。

【理智：62/150】

一晚上的时间，许默的理智已经降到了62点，相较于昨日，他的视线开始出现重影，周围的空间似乎都有些微微扭曲。

再这么下去，他不知道会发生什么。

“必须想办法解决。”

迈着沉重的步子，许默开始向四周探索，有了昨日的教训，只要在聊天频道内确认没有危险的东西，他都尽可能的收集起来。

枯草、树杈、散落的石块、种子、花……

【获得“鲜花”X1】

【理智：63/150】

许默先是一愣，随后下意识看了眼负重栏内的【鲜花】X10，“难道说……”

为了印证心中的想法，他目光再次看向了远处一朵鲜花，就这样，花费了小半天的时间，当负重栏内的鲜花数量变成X20的时候。

理智再次增加一点。

【理智：64/150】

“果然如此！”

许默大喜过望，原来鲜花不仅可以食用，还能增加理智值，虽然采集10朵才增加1点，但聊胜无于。

这是目前，许默发现的，唯一能够恢复理智值的办法。

想到这，他顿时来了精神，目光开始继续搜寻，试图寻找更多的鲜花，但很快他就发现了另一个问题……

鲜花的数量，实在是太少了。

照这个进度下去，即便花费一整天的时间，估计也只能恢复10点左右的理智值，这速度根本无法抵消夜晚的消耗。

要不了几天，他的理智值终究还是会归零。

而到时他将面临的……

许默脸色阴沉，好不容易才解决了食物的问题，没想到又遇到了新的麻烦，而且这些麻烦一个比一个要命！

忙活了大半天，饱腹、体力都到了危险的程度。

许默不得不找个地方休息，一边恢复体力，一边拿出酒水解决饥渴。

“嗯？”

【天赋-酿酒师：你无需任何食谱，即可尝试酿造各种酒水，饮用后获得不同效果。】

“对啊！”

许默激动的一拍大腿，酿酒师天赋的介绍说的很清楚，他能酿造各种酒水，饮用后获得的效果也不尽相同。

既然鲜花能恢复理智，那如果用来酿酒呢？

说干就干！

许默二话不说，立刻打开交易行，又活了一天，昨天剩下的幸存点数上涨了10点，当前剩余：212。

他先是花费了50个幸存点，换了10个单位的水。

随后点开【制作】【酿酒】，分别放入了【水】和【鲜花】。

经过数次尝试后，当二者的比例来到了2：5的时候，下面的【制作】按钮终于亮了起来。

【获得“花酿”X1】

“成功了！”许默激动的大喊起来，随后他忐忑不安的喝下去，尽管酿造成功，可效果依旧未知。

这次的酒水带着一股芬芳，入喉的瞬间甚至让人有种愉悦的感觉。

【干渴：106/150】

【理智：84/150】

干渴值和理智值，分别增加了20点！

原本10个单位鲜花，仅能增加1点理智，但制作成“花酿”后，5个单位的鲜花，就增加20点理智，效果足足翻了40倍！

许默如法炮制，将20单位的鲜花全部制作成了“花酿”。

再次饮下两份花酿后，理智终于恢复到了健康水平的124点，眼前的重影、扭曲，也终于消失了。

许默长舒口气，从今往后，只要能采集到鲜花，那么理智就不用担心了。

看着仅剩的一个“花酿”，许默生出了一个想法。

“要是把这个挂在交易行，会怎么样？”

目前除非是自带相关天赋，大多数人应该都没有找到具体恢复理智的办法吧？就算有人跟他一样，发现了鲜花能够恢复理智，那也是杯水车薪。

这个时候，他要是把“花酿”拿去交易？

许默眼睛眯了起来，仅仅片刻后，就做出了行动。

【花酿X1】

【交易点数：50幸存点】

【备注：可恢复20点理智值，20点干渴值】

50幸存点！

许默知道，这对于大多数人来说都是一个天价，但是为了活命，肯定有人愿意交易，就算一时半会卖不出去也没关系，让子弹飞一会。

就在这时，一个好友申请忽然弹了出来。

【编号36454160申请通过好友。】

【申请备注：你好，方便聊聊吗？】

非法请求-2
content_en:
"There are only more than 3,000 people left."

If he remembered correctly, there were more than 6,000 people in the current area in the afternoon. When night fell, more than 2,000 people were dead?

The chat channel, which had been slightly silent, was now buzzing with excitement.

[Number 64568234: Damn, it’s so scary. It turned dark just now, and it seemed like something passed in front of me.】

[No. 35684521: Fortunately, I made the torch in advance. It seems that darkness is the scariest thing.】

[No. 23678523: Just for a while?Did so many people die?What happened to those people?】

[No. 00264781: Help!Is anyone nearby?My torch is almost out, there are black shadows wandering nearby, they are about to pounce, help...]

The last voice message ended abruptly.

The entire chat channel fell into dead silence, and then completely exploded.

[Number 12562123: Brother, are you still there?brother?】

[No. 65861352: What should I do?My torch doesn't seem to last long. Who has extra branches to trade, food, water... whatever it takes!】

[Number 20359421: What kind of monster is it?I don’t have enough survival points to change, wuwuwu - I don’t want to die.】

There is an atmosphere of panic in the channel. Half of the people died on the first day alone. Can they really survive in this world?

Xu Mo broke out in a cold sweat. If he had acted a little later, would he have encountered that kind of monster?

He glanced at the darkness around him with his peripheral vision, and the creepy feeling came over him again.

His nerves had been tense for a day, and he was already tired, but he didn't dare to sleep at this time. He forced himself to stare at the torch in front of him that still had 85% durability left, and took the opportunity to make two more.

Fortunately, he picked up enough branches and dead grass during the day, so he didn't have to worry about running out.

The number of branches and dead grass that was originally traded in the trading house was decreasing visibly to the naked eye. Xu Mo clicked to open his own transaction order.

[Current Transaction: None]

[Survival points: 270]

"This..."

What an exaggeration!

It's only been half an hour since he hung up those drinks?Just gone?

After looking at the weight-bearing rails and more than 20 drinks, he tried to hang one. This time, he got 15 survival points.

The moment it is hung up, the transaction is immediately displayed as successful.

"Going crazy!"

Xu Mo swallowed. This group of people's demand for water and food was far more crazy than he imagined.

Looking at the 285 survival points in his hand, Xu Mo felt like he was holding a huge sum of money. Although the current transaction price was very attractive, Xu Mo still stayed rational and did not sell the remaining drinks rashly.

The survival points of 285 are already extremely exaggerated.

After flipping through more than a dozen pages, Xu Mo saw two things that were of interest to him.

【Stewed meat (food recipe)】

[Trading points: 35 points]

[Simple campfire (drawing)]

[Trading points: 40 points]

"Food recipes and drawings?"

Xu Mo's eyes lit up and he immediately chose the transaction without much hesitation.

After the transaction was successful and the blueprint was activated, his original [Production] interface had two more options.

【Stew】

[Production requirements: water x2, fresh meat x1]

【Simple campfire】

[Production requirements: Stone x5, wood x2]

Xu Mo frowned.

Although this [Stewed Meat] looks good, the requirements are a bit too stringent. [Fresh Meat] is available in the trading shop, but the price is not cheap.

Xu Mo thought about it, but there was no need to try it for the time being.

As for [Simple Bonfire], the stones and wood required for its production can be obtained through stone pickaxes and axes.

Unfortunately, during the day, Xu Mo did not see any stones that could be mined.

Fortunately, the prices of these two items in the trading house were not particularly expensive. Xu Mo only spent 3 survival points to get the required materials.

After he was fully prepared, he clicked [Create] and [Place] in sequence.

Immediately afterwards, a cluster of fire appeared instantly.

A bonfire surrounded by stones came into view, with flames burning on it, illuminating an area several times larger than the original torch!

After the chill was dispelled, Xu Mo's tense nerves relaxed.

Then he discovered that he could add fuel to it, whether it was "withered grass", "twigs" or "wood", as long as it could burn, everything would work.

In this way, he finally didn't have to worry about the torch burning out, and Xu Mo spent the night guarding the bonfire.

The next morning, when the surrounding light became bright again, Xu Mo, who had not slept all night, was a little tired, but he still managed to stand up.

It's not time to sleep yet.

[Sanity: 62/150]

Over the course of one night, Xu Mo's sanity had dropped to 62 points. Compared with yesterday, his vision began to appear double, and the surrounding space seemed slightly distorted.

If this continues, he doesn't know what will happen.

"We have to find a way to solve it."

Taking heavy steps, Xu Mo began to explore around. With yesterday's lesson, he would collect as much as possible as long as he confirmed that there were no dangerous things in the chat channel.

Dead grass, tree branches, scattered stones, seeds, flowers...

【Get "Flowers" X1】

[Sanity: 63/150]

Xu Mo was stunned for a moment, then subconsciously glanced at the [Flowers] X10 in the weight-bearing column, "Could it be that..."

In order to confirm what he was thinking, he looked at a flower in the distance again. Just like this, it took him half a day, when the number of flowers in the load-bearing column became X20.

A little more sanity again.

[Sanity: 64/150]

"As expected!"

Xu Mo was overjoyed. It turned out that flowers were not only edible, but also increased his sanity. Although collecting 10 flowers only increased his sanity by 1 point, it was no better than that.

This is currently the only way Xu Mo has found to restore his sanity.

Thinking of this, he suddenly became energetic and began to search with his eyes, trying to find more flowers, but soon he discovered another problem...

The number of flowers is really too few.

At this pace, even if it takes a whole day, it is estimated that only about 10 points of sanity can be restored. This speed cannot offset the consumption of the night.

In a few days, his sanity will eventually return to zero.

And what he will face then...

Xu Mo's face was gloomy. He finally solved the food problem, but he didn't expect to encounter new troubles, and each of these troubles was more serious than the last!

After working for a long time, my full stomach and physical strength were dangerously high.

Xu Mo had to find a place to rest, while recovering his strength, he took out drinks to satisfy his thirst.

"Huh?"

[Talent - Brewer: You can try brewing various drinks without any recipes, and you will get different effects after drinking them.】

"Yes!"

Xu Mo slapped his thigh excitedly. The introduction of the winemaker's talent made it very clear that he could brew various drinks, and the effects obtained after drinking them were also different.

Since flowers can restore sanity, what if they are used to make wine?

Just do it!

Without saying a word, Xu Mo immediately opened the trading house and survived for another day. The remaining surviving points from yesterday increased by 10 points, and the current remaining points are: 212.

He first spent 50 survival points and changed 10 units of water.

Then click on [Creation] and [Wine Brewing], and put in [Water] and [Flowers] respectively.

After several attempts, when the ratio between the two reached 2:5, the [Create] button below finally lit up.

[Get "Flower Brew" X1]

"Successful!" Xu Mo shouted excitedly, and then he drank it uneasily. Although the brewing was successful, the effect was still unknown.

The drink this time has a fragrance, and it even makes people feel happy the moment it enters the throat.

【Thirst: 106/150】

[Sanity: 84/150]

Thirst value and sanity value increased by 20 points each!

Originally, 10 units of flowers could only increase 1 point of sanity, but after being made into "flower brew", 5 units of flowers could increase 20 points of sanity, a full 40 times the effect!

Xu Mo followed suit and made 20 units of flowers into "flower brew".

After drinking two portions of flower brew again, his sanity finally returned to a healthy level of 124 points, and the double images and distortions in front of him finally disappeared.

Xu Mo breathed a sigh of relief. From now on, as long as he could collect flowers, he wouldn't have to worry about his sanity.

Looking at the only "flower brew" left, Xu Mo had an idea.

“What would happen if we put this in a trading house?”

At present, unless they have related talents, most people should not have found a specific way to restore their sanity, right?Even if someone, like him, discovered that flowers could restore sanity, it would be a drop in the bucket.

At this time, what if he trades "Hua Yong"?

Xu Mo narrowed his eyes and took action after only a moment.

【Flower brew X1】

[Trading Points: 50 Survival Points]

[Remarks: It can restore 20 points of sanity and 20 points of thirst]

50 survival points!

Xu Mo knew that this was a sky-high price for most people, but in order to survive, someone must be willing to trade. Even if it couldn't be sold for a while, it didn't matter. Let the bullets fly for a while.

At this moment, a friend request suddenly popped up.

[No. 36454160 applied through friends.】

[Application Note: Hello, is it convenient for us to chat?】

Illegal request-2
title_en: Famine for All: SSS-Level Talented Winemaker_Linglan Qianxia_Chapter 3 Going crazy!
